signal-runner.title: Signal Runner
signal-runner.description: A fast-paced game concept combining movement, rhythm, and clear visual cues.
signal-runner.imageAlt: Futuristic player character on a glowing track

content.heading: The Idea
paragraphs: Signal Runner explores how a small number of precise cues can make a fast-paced experience easy to read. Movement and obstacles follow a shared visual rhythm.

content.heading: The Prototype
paragraphs: The playable prototype focuses on movement, immediate feedback, and short iteration cycles. Systems and visuals were developed together so that every mechanic remains easy to understand.

modular-input-deck.title: Modular Input Deck
modular-input-deck.description: A customizable control deck for creative workflows and rapid hardware prototyping.
modular-input-deck.imageAlt: Modular input device with rotary controls and switches

content.heading: Designed to Be Modular
paragraphs: The input deck combines rotary controls, buttons, and sliders in interchangeable modules. This allows the interface to be adapted to different tasks.

content.heading: From Assembly to Interaction
paragraphs: The design considers assembly, cable routing, and tactile orientation from the outset. Cyan status indicators carry the portfolio's visual language into the physical product.

portfolio-system.title: Portfolio System
portfolio-system.description: A statically generated portfolio with centralized project data and flexible thematic views.
portfolio-system.imageAlt: Responsive portfolio displayed on a laptop and smartphone

content.heading: One Source, Many Views
paragraphs: All project information is maintained in one central location. The static build uses it to generate the general overview, thematic portfolios, and every individual project page.

content.heading: Static and Context-Aware
paragraphs: Project links preserve their origin in a URL parameter. The detail page validates this context and returns visitors to the appropriate thematic overview while remaining directly accessible.
